panels.description: Underwater, TJ's detached leg drags his head through old mine rails toward the pulsing magnet. Keep the route readable in murky lake water.
The leg snaps back onto TJ's head through magnetic force. Keep the joining parts dominant and leave upper water space for the sound.
TJ's torso and remaining legs arrive from separate directions through the water and dock shadows. Keep his dog silhouette readable despite the mismatched parts.
TJ climbs the dock crookedly carrying a broken drone component in his mouth-like front assembly. Leave upper dock space clear.
